stages.task: Classify request and select the next mode.

outline_workflow.description: Expand a direction into a novel outline.

stages.task: Clarify genre, promise, target reader, and commercial tags.
Retrieve analogous structures when available and abstract them.
Draft world rules and conflict sources.
Draft protagonist, antagonist, supporting cast, and relationships.
Create volume structure, chapter beats, hooks, payoff, and pacing.
Identify weak motive, repetitive payoff, and continuity risks.
Extract premise and genre constraints.
Build rules, factions, resources, geography, hierarchy, limits, taboo, and cost.
Check contradictions and loopholes.

character_workflow.description: Design character arcs and relationship tension.

stages.task: Build cast, desire, wound, misunderstanding, reversal, and growth.
Connect character desire to plot conflict.
Flag weak motivation and flat relationships.

chapter_writing_workflow.description: Draft a chapter from outline and memory.

stages.task: Select chapter goal and scene constraints.
Write prose with conflict, emotional movement, payoff, setup, and ending hook.
Control voice, sentence rhythm, dialogue ratio, and web-novel momentum.
Check contradictions before final output.
Propose memory updates.
Scan memory, outline, chapters, and references for contradictions.
Prioritize issues and repair steps.
List memory updates needed after repair.
Search ReferenceLibrary, TaciturnRaw, Bridges, AbstractLibrary, memory, and learnings.
Abstract reusable mechanics without copying prose.

code_workflow.description: Use Codex coding ability through adapter for explicitly requested code work.

stages.task: Define edit scope and verification plan.
Delegate to Codex exec adapter when enabled.
